record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Go<WH0935><WTH8798> in unto Pharaoh<WH06547>: for I have hardened<WH03513><WTH8689> his heart<WH03820>, and the heart<WH03820> of his servants<WH05650>, that I might shew<WH07896><WTH8800> these my signs<WH0226> before<WH07130> him:
